about: Hi, I'm Guilherme. Nice to meet you.
aboutDescription: Since I started my journey as a full stack developer two years ago, I have worked on projects alongside colleagues in the field, participated in competitions that challenged my knowledge and skills, both technical and interpersonal, and gained practical experience. I also had the opportunity to work as an intern at Achievo, where I learned a lot and grew professionally.
frontDescription: I build modern and responsive interfaces, focusing on accessibility and user experience. I aim to create intuitive layouts and reusable components for easier maintenance and scalability.
backDescription: I structure efficient and secure APIs, ensuring clean code and best development practices. I enjoy working with modular architecture and optimizing communication between front and back.
scienceDescription: I have a solid foundation in programming and problem-solving. I prioritize clean, well-structured code and always seek best practices to make development more efficient and scalable.
